cd "F:/Projekty/Pluginy Laravel/beziworld-github-profile" && python - <<'EOF'
p='profile/README.md'
s=open(p,encoding='utf-8').read()
a="| [laravel-uldk]"
row="| [laravel-krs](https://github.com/Beziworld/laravel-krs) | KRS open API: company extracts, board and representation, shareholders, status flags, daily change bulletin watcher |\n"
s=s.replace(a,row+a,1)
open(p,'w',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n').write(s)
EOF
grep -c "| \[laravel-" profile/README.md; git add -A && git commit -q -m "docs: add laravel-krs to the package catalogue" && git push -q origin master; git log --oneline -1

cd "F:/Projekty/Pluginy Laravel/beziworld-github-profile" && python - <<'EOF'
p='profile/README.md'
s=open(p,encoding='utf-8').read()
a="| [laravel-directadmin]"
i=s.index(a); j=s.index("\n",i)+1
rows=("| [laravel-cpanel](https://github.com/Beziworld/laravel-cpanel) | cPanel UAPI and WHM: accounts, packages, SSO, domains, DNS, e-mail, MySQL, SSL, FTP, cron, backups |\n"
"| [laravel-plesk](https://github.com/Beziworld/laravel-plesk) | Plesk REST and XML API: customers, subscriptions, DNS, databases, mail, Let's Encrypt, CLI gate |\n"
"| [laravel-cloudflare](https://github.com/Beziworld/laravel-cloudflare) | Cloudflare API v4: zones, DNS, cache purge, SSL/TLS, WAF, Turnstile rule, trusted proxies middleware |\n")
s=s[:j]+rows+s[j:]
s=s.replace("## Hosting","## Hosting and DNS")
open(p,'w',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n').write(s)
EOF
grep -c "| \[laravel-" profile/README.md; git add -A && git commit -q -m "docs: add cPanel, Plesk and Cloudflare packages to the catalogue" && git push -q origin master; git log --oneline -1
